items.question: Under the UAE federal human resources law, within how many working days must a federal employee challenge an administrative penalty in writing to the Grievance Committee after receiving notification?
items.gold: Within five working days of receiving a notification.
items.fact: Federal employees challenge penalties within five working days, in writing.

items.question: Under Dubai Government's Law No. 8 of 2018 on human resources, can a member of the Grievances and Complaints Committee also be a member of the Work-related Offences Committee?
items.gold: No, a member of the Grievances and Complaints Committee cannot be a member of the Work-related Offences Committee.
items.fact: Dubai grievance and offences committee members cannot overlap.
